featured_reviews.name: Aparna Howal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Akshay salon. I travelled all the way from Vikhroli to Virar for a hair color service, and unfortunately the entire visit turned out to be frustrating and unprofessional.

First, the pricing was extremely misleading. The price list clearly mentions ₹6000 for global color for hair below the shoulders and haircut for 800rs, yet I was charged ₹8500. When I questioned this, the stylist (Shruti) said the price included a haircut and gave a discount.But my hair is not even waist-length, so the higher price did not make sense.

Secondly, the service quality was poor. I was at the salon for more than four hours, and nobody even offered something as basic as water. Basic customer care seemed completely absent.

Most importantly, the final hair color result was not what I asked for. I clearly explained the shade I wanted, but shruti did not understand the requirement and the result looked completely different. When the color did not show properly, instead of taking responsibility, I was repeatedly asked whether I had used henna or other products on my hair, which I never do. Later I was told my hair “has changed over time,” which honestly did not sound like a valid explanation.

What made this more confusing is that three years ago I got the exact same color done at the same salon and the result was great. At that time I was charged ₹6000 and the service was good. Now suddenly I’m being told my hair has changed and that’s why the color didn’t show. The explanation kept changing—first I was told I don’t even have 10% grey hair, and later she said at least the grey hair was covered.

The most disappointing part was the response from the owner. When I said I was not satisfied with the result and it doesn’t even look like I got a hair color done, then she went towards the owner and they discussed something and she came and told me I need to pay extra if I need the color fixed, I would need to pay again for bleaching and come back another day. After already paying ₹8500, that felt completely unreasonable.

I paid the full amount hoping they might at least acknowledge my dissatisfaction or adjust the price, but instead I was simply told that prices have increased. If that’s the case, the price list should be updated instead of misleading customers in their website.

Overall, this experience felt like a waste of time, money, and effort. Even near by my area have good salon and better service with reasonable price, but I still choose this salon because of my last service. I have attached my before and after color picture. I would never ever recommend anyone. The only regret is I should have not giving that much amount for such a disaster service.
